verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents per-chat tool approval modes with Allow/Deny tool cards for coding-agent supervision (docs-13, docs-37), which directly matches the approval-prompt/opt-in elevated mode pattern. However, evidence doesn't show a granular command allowlist system or admin-configurable per-action policy beyond the chat-level approval toggle, and there's no independent/community corroboration of this specific feature working as documented. missing for 10: command allowlist configuration, admin-level policy enforcement across users, independent hands-on verification of the approval UI.
